purpose: legislators:PK:Balochistan:general seats for constituencies PB-1 to PB-50
query: List the CURRENT members of the Provincial Assembly of Balochistan (Balochistan, Pakistan) holding the general seats for constituencies PB-1 to PB-50, as of 2026-11-15. For each member give full name, constituency code and name (for constituency seats), seat type (general, women_reserved, minority_reserved, other_reserved), party name and acronym, term start, whether the seat was won in a by-election, and source URLs that list this person as a member for this seat. Account for by-elections, deaths, resignations and disqualifications since the general election; omit vacant seats.
text: As of 15 November 2026, 49 general-seat members are listed for PB-1–PB-50. PB-21 is omitted: the election commission suspended Ali Hassan Zehri’s returned-candidate notification on 27 February 2026, and he is absent from the assembly’s current member directory. The March 2026 PB-36 re-poll and the PB-45 and PB-50 re-polls are not classified as by-elections; PB-8, PB-20 and PB-22 are.
